if (!listener)  // Nothing to do with a null listener!
    return NS_OK;

* @throw NS_ERROR_INVALID_ARG - Indicates that listener was either null or
   *   that it does not support weak references.

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The registerListener documentation says a null listener produces NS_ERROR_INVALID_ARG. RegisterListener instead retains an early null guard that returns NS_OK. UnregisterListener does not share that no-op and returns NS_ERROR_INVALID_ARG when it cannot obtain a weak reference. Keep those concrete method contracts separate when reviewing callers or correcting the documentation. The mismatch is present in the owned weak-listener change and the fixed accepted source; this study does not choose or implement a behavior change.
title: The progress listener null-registration comment differs from the implementation
